observes: AUDITIA, 300 vectors in graph ia-0602, complete IVF index answers 300. During a real ivf_build rebuild (build_batch_size=1) a second connection's ivf_search answered fewer than 300 in 35 of 44 searches (min 7), no error. A rebuild killed by SIGKILL mid-way left an index answering 12 of 300 with no error, and IVFIndex.Info reported indexed=0 while 12 vectors answered. Fail is relative to the working contract in decisions.md HD-0602 (complete published index or explicit unavailable); no spec/ADR states a build contract, so this is not by itself a product-defect claim. An earlier attempt that closed the builder's connection from another thread crashed the client driver (rc 139, log kept as hd0602_ivf_partial.crashed-attempt1.log, cleaned up).
